text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear yeee!!
This summer, I willlllllll!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: This summer, we are gonnaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I hereby swwwweaaar off Biko-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm going to cut out Biko-chan cold turkeeeey...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, what's that supposed to mean, Bono?!

—Summer training camp. This summer began
with a sudden declaration from Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know... whenever I'm with you, Biko-chan,
I just get so happy that I can't help wanting to play~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If things stay like this, I'll get a bit lazy,
my appetite will ramp up,
and maybe I'll even grow over 3 meters tall~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So this summer, I'm gonna steel my heart like a horned turban snail
and train all on my own!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Bye-bye, Biko-chan!!!
BOOOOONOOOO!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Aaah!? Bono--!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...!
choice_data_list: I'm sure Hishi Akebono is being completely serious.
I'm sure Hishi Akebono is totally serious.

text_block_list.text: Seeing Biko Pegasus run had lit a fire within, making it impossible to just sit back and do nothing.
As her best friend, I must not do anything that would dull Hishi Akebono's resolve.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: “I see... It's lonely, but this is a critical summer for Bono too. In that case...”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I will wait! For the day Bono somehow breaks out of the Monster Graveyard!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, puhaa*... Until now,
my body felt squishy. But I can feel it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's gradually tightening up nicely☆
Just a little more. Just a little more and—!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: This is my peak season!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono! She's finally claimed her first victory!
Despite a string of losses up until now on
miles and dirt—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Her talent has finally blossomed on the 1,200m turf!
With a spectacular burst of speed, she blows right past the competition!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Buono~!!
It turned out delicious~!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, Bono!
You've finally done it, Trainer!

Sometimes, keeping some distance from your friends is important.
Spending a summer on her own seems to have been
a wonderful turning point for Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Bono is doing her best.
Everyone else is doing their best too. In that case—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna try even harder!
Full steam ahead, let's go, Trainer!
